issues.t: rds: six control-plane lifecycle flows never reach their terminal status, so the checks that poll them are killed at the 60 s budget
rds: an Oracle DB instance publishes Endpoint.Address as a real *.rds.amazonaws.com host the emulator does not serve, so no Oracle data plane is reachable
secretsmanager: an RDS-managed master user secret outlives its deleted DB cluster
rds: invalid-input and not-found refusals are never raised — four requests AWS rejects answer HTTP 200
rds: global-cluster, proxy and cluster envelopes carry placeholder ids, unserved endpoints and omit modeled members (7 causes)
rds: DB cluster envelopes publish a random listener port instead of the engine port (6 causes)
rds-data: ExecuteStatement column metadata reports isAutoIncrement true for a non-identity column
Implement rds RestoreDBInstanceToPointInTime: unimplemented scaffold stub
rds: 4 net-new causes — proxy targets never become registered, and the connections metric, Serverless v2 capacity and IAM-token expiry paths never settle
rds: 10 net-new causes — the SQL endpoints are a generic shim, not MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL: dialect, catalogs, server variables, constraint errors and privilege boundaries all diverge
rds: 10 net-new causes — reader/proxy/SQL Server endpoints are unreachable AWS hostnames, requested ports are ignored, and several refusals, restores and backups diverge
rds serves emulator-authored values on success paths: engine-default parameter rows and the global-cluster resource id
rds DB proxy lifecycle refusals diverge: a deleted proxy is still found, and the invalid-state message is emulator-worded

rds: 3 net-new causes — an aurora-postgresql cluster publishes Port as an ephemeral listener port, a REPEATABLE READ transaction gets no stable snapshot, and a lock-waiting statement is cancelled with a non-PostgreSQL Qu

DescribeDBEngineVersions serves a synthetic engine-version catalog for Aurora MySQL, Aurora PostgreSQL, custom SQL Server, Db2, DocumentDB, MariaDB, MySQL, Neptune and Oracle EE

RDS cluster and subnet-group refusals carry the wrong error class and message: state faults for missing clusters, not-found for a non-member cluster
rds: the aurora-postgresql cluster+writer engine-truth flow never becomes usable — the check reaches no SQL assertion before its 180 s budget expires
rds: a GenerateDBAuthToken token is not scoped to the DB instance endpoint DescribeDBInstances publishes, so IAM database authentication cannot be exercised
rds: 5 net-new causes in the IAM-role-association surface — a malformed RoleArn is accepted, and every AddRoleToDB{Instance,Cluster} refusal carries an emulator-authored code or message
rds global cluster mutation envelopes carry a placeholder resource id and the wrong delete status
rds cluster-role and export refusals answer the wrong message and the wrong error class
rds: a DB subnet group's reported Availability Zones are hashed from the subnet id instead of resolved from EC2, so a two-AZ group reads back as covering one AZ
